vc_checking.summary: All seven current manual VCs are semantically provable under the accepted dispatch annotation and case-lib definitions. The implementation witnesses share one DLL decomposition/reclosure helper family; the two derived client specifications reduce the unified dispatch result using sentinel equality or member non-sentinelness. No witness requires changing generated statements or the annotation-approved seed declarations.

Unfold dispatch using node<>head, then use the first-occurrence equation for xizi_double_link_next_value over nodes_before ++ node :: nodes_after.

node<>head and all non-null facts come from the nonempty constructors traversed by xizi_dllseg

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Open or structurally split the circular dllseg, derive endpoint/list facts, reduce the list-level dispatch definition, and reclose the unchanged ownership.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use structural dllseg induction helpers for first-member split, stop=nil, and prefix/query/suffix reclosure; use existing xizi_dll_open/close and xizi_dllseg_unfold at witness boundaries.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Use earliest-occurrence list decomposition, constructor non-null/non-sentinel guards, and direct unfolding of first_value/next_value/dispatch_value.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: Seven witnesses are below the controller limit of 12, belong to one function, and reuse one tightly coupled DLL segment/dispatch helper family. Keeping them together lets one worker prove each suffixed helper once and use it across the decomposition, return, and derived-spec witnesses.

forbidden_lemma_review.worker_instruction: Prove the candidate helpers by direct structural induction, sep_apply/cancel/entailer-style reasoning, and direct definition unfolding. Do not invoke any forbidden lemma, including derivable reflexivity/transitivity, sepcon monotonicity/commutativity/associativity lemmas, or listed logic-equivalence shortcuts. Keep helpers in the suffixed group-local case_lib and keep the manual file helper-free.

candidate_helper_declarations.purpose: reduce the member dispatch result at the earliest list occurrence
expose the prefix, queried-node links, suffix, and representation guards from xizi_dll membership
reclose prefix, queried-node links, and suffix into the full segment
show a member query is distinct from the sentinel before unfolding dispatch

proof_groups.proof_strategy: First prove the five suffixed helpers in the group-local case_lib using direct list/dllseg induction and no forbidden lemma. Prove entail_wit_1 by splitting anchor into sentinel/member and applying open or first-member split. Prove return_wit_1/2/3/4 by selecting the branch matching the recorded guard, deriving empty/nonempty suffix value, joining when needed, and closing xizi_dll. Prove both derived specs by choosing the same abstract list and constructing the wand by direct adjunction; for member dispatch first derive node<>head from head-not-in.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: The concrete list ownership never changes. The proof only changes its view: whole circular list, sentinel-open view, or prefix/query/suffix view. The pure result follows from whether the selected link points to the sentinel or to the first element of a nonempty suffix. The derived specs specialize the unified dispatch definition to node=head or node<>head.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All seven witnesses are within the maximum group size, share one DLL structural helper family, and should be proved sequentially by one worker so the suffixed helper declarations are proved once. Splitting derived specs into a second group would duplicate the head-not-in/dispatch reasoning without a true dependency boundary.
